card.line: Tekoa was a town in Judah, south of Jerusalem, home of a wise woman who spoke to David and of the prophet Amos the shepherd.

moments.title: Joab sends for a wise woman
moments.text: Joab wanted David to bring Absalom home. He sent to Tekoa for a wise woman and told her to act like a mourner and speak to the king.

moments.title: The woman of Tekoa pleads with David
moments.text: The woman of Tekoa told David a story about her two sons. She asked him to protect her surviving son, and David vowed not a hair of his head would fall. Then she showed that the king had not brought back his own banished son.

moments.title: Rehoboam fortifies Tekoa
moments.text: Rehoboam built up cities in Judah for defense, and Tekoa was one of them. He added strong walls, officers, supplies, shields, and spears.

moments.title: Jehoshaphat's call to believe
moments.text: Early in the morning the people left for the Wilderness of Tekoa. Jehoshaphat told them to believe in the LORD their God and in His prophets, and they would be upheld and succeed.

moments.title: Amos the shepherd of Tekoa
moments.text: Amos was among the sheepherders of Tekoa. His words about Israel were given in the days when Uzziah was king of Judah.
